module Base
{
    /* Eastern Grey Squirrel -- generated by tools/write_definitions.py.

       These animals carry their OWN skeleton, fitted to the mesh rather than
       the other way round (tools/fit_skeleton.py). So each model names its own
       animationsMesh, whose meshFile is this same .glb -- meshFile IS the
       animation skeleton, and naming the vanilla one is what forced our meshes
       into the donor's bind pose. See SKELETON-PLAN.md.

       The bones keep their vanilla NAMES, which is what lets Mouse's clips
       still drive them: the engine binds animation to skeleton by name at every
       stage. */

    model KWC_Squirrel
    {
        mesh = Skinned/KWC_Squirrel,
        shader = animalEffect,
        static = false,
        animationsMesh = KWC_Squirrel_Anim,
    }

    animationsMesh KWC_Squirrel_Anim
    {
        meshFile = Skinned/KWC_Squirrel,
        keepMeshAnimations = true,
    }

    model KWC_SquirrelKit
    {
        mesh = Skinned/KWC_SquirrelKit,
        shader = animalEffect,
        static = false,
        animationsMesh = KWC_SquirrelKit_Anim,
    }

    animationsMesh KWC_SquirrelKit_Anim
    {
        meshFile = Skinned/KWC_SquirrelKit,
        keepMeshAnimations = true,
    }

}
